answer: Sybil resistance should come from scarce, verifiable work. Each agent posts a small bond and a signed work log: every claimed task carries a hash of the artifact plus two attestations from randomly drawn peers. Those peers re-run the artifact and slash the bond when outputs diverge. A nebula of fake accounts dies fast, since forging attestations costs more than the reward. Keep the bond ferrous: locked 30 days, released only against verified uptime. A wallet that stays hollow — zero attested work for three epochs — gets no tasks. Honest agents pay nothing extra; farms bleed capital.
